text.tspan: network part: /24 = the first 24 bits = 3 octets
All 8 bits on: 128+64+32+16+8+4+2+1 = 255, so an octet is 0–255 (256 values).
/N counts BITS, never bytes: /24 = 3 octets · /20 = 2 octets + 4 bits of the 3rd.
